name: Afraid Squid 51
author: andrew-demchenk0
description: Gray button that responds while pressed down with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: While pressed, box-shadow becomes 0px 0px #323232, transform becomes translate(3px, 3px).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Afraid Squid 51</title>
<style>
/* Afraid Squid 51 by andrew-demchenk0 — https://uiverse.io/andrew-demchenk0/afraid-squid-51 */
.button {
  --font-color: #323232;
  --bg-color: #fff;
  --main-color: #323232;
  width: 120px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border: 2px solid var(--main-color);
  background-color: var(--bg-color);
  box-shadow: 4px 4px var(--main-color);
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--font-color);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.button:active {
  box-shadow: 0px 0px var(--main-color);
  transform: translate(3px, 3px);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Let`s go →
</button>

</body>
</html>
